title: Blue Bounces!
topic: why the sky is blue, for five-year-olds

scenes.narration: Look up! The sky is blue. Where does the blue come from?
scenes.visualAction: Wide low-angle shot: Wally stands in a grassy field and points straight up at a huge flat blue sky that fills the top of the frame.

scenes.narration: Sunlight looks plain white. But every colour is hiding inside it.
scenes.visualAction: Medium shot on a dark background: one narrow white sunbeam cuts across the frame, and Wally leans in close to peer along it.

scenes.narration: Let the light out, and a rainbow jumps free. Red, yellow, green, blue!
scenes.visualAction: Snap cut to a close shot: the white beam strikes a clear glass block and springs out of the far side as a wide rainbow fan that sweeps across the frame.

scenes.narration: Blue is the tiny bouncy colour. Red is the big slow one.
scenes.visualAction: Split frame: on the left a small blue ball bounces fast and high, on the right a big red ball rolls slowly in a straight line, and Wally looks from one side to the other.

scenes.narration: The air looks empty. It is not! It is full of tiny bits.
scenes.visualAction: The camera pushes in slowly on plain blue air until countless pale specks drift into view, and Wally steps in beside them and taps one.

scenes.narration: Big slow red goes straight past the tiny bits. Whoosh!
scenes.visualAction: Flat side-on diagram shot: a big red ball rolls through a drifting field of specks in one straight line and leaves the frame, while Wally tracks it with a sweeping point.

scenes.narration: Little blue hits them and bounces away. Boing! Boing!
scenes.visualAction: The same side-on diagram: a small blue ball enters, strikes speck after speck, and ricochets in a new direction on every hit, with a snappy held pose at each bounce.

scenes.narration: Blue bounces all over the sky. Say it with me: blue bounces!
scenes.visualAction: Fast pull back to a wide shot: hundreds of blue balls ricochet across the sky until the frame turns solid blue, and Wally cheers from the bottom corner.

scenes.narration: So blue comes down to your eyes from every part of the sky.
scenes.visualAction: Ground-level shot from behind Wally: thin blue arrows rain down from every part of the sky and meet at the spot where he stands looking up.

scenes.narration: The sky is not blue because of the sea. Deserts have blue sky too!
scenes.visualAction: Hard wipe from a blue sea to a dry orange desert under the same blue sky, where Wally stands on the sand and shakes his head at a crossed-out wave symbol.

scenes.narration: At sunset the light travels far. The blue bounces away, and red stays.
scenes.visualAction: Slow wide shot: the sun sinks, its long light path stretches across the frame, blue balls peel off to the sides, and the sky fades to orange and red around Wally.

scenes.narration: The sky is blue because blue bounces. Blue bounces everywhere!
scenes.visualAction: Back to the opening field: the camera tilts up from Wally to the full blue sky while a few blue balls bounce past the frame.
